nodes.label: ORE Shared Types Schema (ore_types.xsd)
nodes.rationale: Root schema file defining shared simple/complex types (dates, currencies, day counters, calendars, schedules) included by both instruments.xsd and curveconfig.xsd; simulation.xsd uses the same type names without an explicit xs:include, implying it is normally merged into a combined master schema.

nodes.label: Instruments Schema (instruments.xsd)
nodes.rationale: Largest of the four files (~5300 lines); defines the master oreTradeData choice group covering ~190 trade-data element bindings across ~150+ distinct trade types plus their shared building blocks (legData, optionData, barrierData, underlying, scripted-trade primitives).

nodes.label: XSD Schema Coverage Caveat
nodes.rationale: These XSD schema files are known to be incomplete/imperfect and do not perfectly represent every real-world ORE XML variation seen in production trade/config files. Treat schema-derived structure as a guide, not ground truth.

nodes.label: bool (simpleType)
nodes.rationale: Lenient string enumeration (Y/YES/TRUE/1/N/NO/FALSE/0/empty) rather than xs:boolean, reflecting historically loose ORE XML boolean encodings.

nodes.label: calendar (simpleType)
nodes.rationale: Extremely large pattern-based enumeration covering hundreds of ISO codes, exchange names, and custom calendar tokens, with a CUSTOM_.* / [A-Z]{4} escape hatch.

nodes.label: volatilityInterpolationType (simpleType)
nodes.rationale: Union of interpolationMethodType and sviModelVariantType, used for TimeInterpolation/StrikeInterpolation on volatility surfaces in curveconfig.xsd.

nodes.label: riskFactorKeyType (simpleType)
nodes.rationale: Enumerates the risk-factor key categories (DiscountCurve, FXVolatility, SurvivalProbability, CPR, etc.) used across ORE's sensitivity/scenario machinery.

nodes.label: scheduleData (complexType)
nodes.rationale: Central reusable building block: a choice of Rules-based, Dates-based, or Derived schedule generation, referenced throughout instruments.xsd for coupon/valuation/exercise schedules.

nodes.label: crossAssetModel (complexType)
nodes.rationale: Central multi-asset model configuration composing per-asset-class model choices (interest rate, FX, equity, inflation, credit, commodity) plus instantaneous correlations.

nodes.label: segmentsType (complexType)
nodes.rationale: Choice group of yield-curve bootstrap segment kinds (Direct, Simple, AverageOIS, TenorBasis, CrossCurrency, ZeroSpread, DiscountRatio, FittedBond, WeightedAverage, YieldPlusDefault, IborFallback).

nodes.label: quoteType (complexType)
nodes.rationale: Generic wrapper for repeated optional market Quote strings, reused across nearly every curve/volatility configuration type.

nodes.label: oreTradeData (xs:group, master trade-data choice)
nodes.rationale: Abstract xs:group listing ~190 element/type bindings; this is the master extension point every ORE trade XML plugs into via the choice of its type-specific *Data element.

nodes.label: oreTradeType (simpleType, trade type enum)
nodes.rationale: Enumerates ~140 TradeType string values; by naming convention each value pairs with one of the *Data element bindings in the oreTradeData group, though the XSD does not explicitly encode that pairing.

nodes.label: legData (complexType)
nodes.rationale: The single most reused structural building block in instruments.xsd: nearly every swap-like, bond-like, and credit trade type embeds one or more LegData elements.

nodes.label: legData_capfloor (complexType)
nodes.rationale: A parallel, slightly stricter variant of legData used specifically by capFloorData (required Notionals/DayCounter/ScheduleData).

nodes.label: legDataType (abstract element, substitution group head)
nodes.rationale: Abstract substitutionGroup head letting legData's LegType-specific payload (FixedLegData, FloatingLegData, CPILegData, etc.) plug in polymorphically.

nodes.label: optionData (complexType)
nodes.rationale: Second most reused building block after legData; embedded by nearly all option-style trade types across FX, equity, commodity, credit, and rates asset classes.

nodes.label: underlyingTypes (abstract element, substitution group head)
nodes.rationale: Lets a trade choose between a bare Name string, a single Underlying, or an Underlyings basket wherever underlyingTypes is referenced (equity/FX/commodity option and forward types).

nodes.label: RangeAccrualLegData (element)
nodes.rationale: Embeds a nested FloatingLegData plus per-period Coupons/UpperBounds/LowerBounds.

nodes.label: swapData (complexType)
nodes.rationale: Bound to Swap, CrossCurrencySwap, InflationSwap and EquitySwap trade-data elements alike (same complexType reused for multiple TradeType names).

nodes.label: fxBarrierOptionData (complexType)
nodes.rationale: Same complexType is bound to FxBarrierOptionData, FxDoubleBarrierOptionData and FxEuropeanBarrierOptionData element names.

nodes.label: eqBarrierOptionData (complexType)
nodes.rationale: Same complexType bound to EquityBarrierOptionData, EquityDoubleBarrierOptionData and EquityEuropeanBarrierOptionData element names.

nodes.label: varianceSwapData (complexType)
nodes.rationale: Reused across VarianceSwapData, EquityVarianceSwapData, FxVarianceSwapData and CommodityVarianceSwapData element bindings.

nodes.label: totalReturnSwapData (complexType)
nodes.rationale: Reused for both TotalReturnSwapData and ContractForDifferenceData element bindings.

nodes.label: trsUnderlyingData (complexType)
nodes.rationale: References the external/undefined subTradeGroup substitution group (not declared within these 4 files), letting a TRS underlying be an arbitrary nested sub-trade.

nodes.label: scriptedTradeData (complexType)
nodes.rationale: Generic payload for ORE's scripted-trade framework: a ScriptName/ProductTag/Script plus a typed Data block (Number/Currency/Index/Event/Daycounter variables) that parameterizes an external payoff script.

nodes.label: stFreeStyle* family (concept: scripted-trade literal/reference primitives)
nodes.rationale: Represents ~24 small complexTypes (stFreeStyleEvent, stFreeStyleNumber, stFreeStyleIndex, stFreeStyleCurrency, stFreeStyleDayCounter, stFreeStyleBool, stFreeStyleOptionType, stFreeStyleLongShort, stFreeStyleBarrierType and their *Vector variants) that let a scripted/exotic trade field be either a literal value or a named reference into scriptedTradeData's Data block. Not each of the ~24 is modeled as its own node in this first chunk.

nodes.label: tarfData2 (complexType, TaRF family)
nodes.rationale: Bound to FxTaRFData, EquityTaRFData and CommodityTaRFData element names.

nodes.label: accumulatorData (complexType, accumulator family)
nodes.rationale: Bound to FxAccumulatorData, EquityAccumulatorData and CommodityAccumulatorData element names.

nodes.label: rainbowOptionData (complexType, rainbow family)
nodes.rationale: Bound to EquityRainbowOptionData, FxRainbowOptionData and CommodityRainbowOptionData; sits alongside ~9 worstPerformanceRainbowOption0N variants and best/worst/min/max rainbow variants not individually modeled here.

nodes.label: genericBarrierOptionData (complexType, generic barrier family)
nodes.rationale: Bound to FxGenericBarrierOptionData, EquityGenericBarrierOptionData and CommodityGenericBarrierOptionData; distinct from the raw-XML genericBarrierOptionDataRaw type bound to plain GenericBarrierOptionData.

nodes.label: worstOfBasketSwapData2 (complexType, worst-of basket family)
nodes.rationale: Bound to FxWorstOfBasketSwapData, EquityWorstOfBasketSwapData and CommodityWorstOfBasketSwapData.

nodes.label: basketOptionData (complexType, basket option family)
nodes.rationale: Bound to EquityBasketOptionData, FxBasketOptionData and CommodityBasketOptionData.
